Three.js r180 (MIT; see THREE-LICENSE.txt).
three.module.js, three.core.js, OrbitControls.js and STLLoader.js were reused
from the existing local flowbase-sim distribution.

GLTFLoader.js and BufferGeometryUtils.js were downloaded from the matching
official r180 tag for the detailed camera GLB assets:
https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/r180/examples/jsm/loaders/GLTFLoader.js
https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/r180/examples/jsm/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js
All dependencies are local. No CDN scripts or runtime network dependencies.
